title: Monthly streamflow gap recoverability diagnosis — method implementation
description: Portable method implementation, frozen JSON diagnostic models, and reproducible real and synthetic cases for Diagnosing the recoverability of monthly streamflow gaps using within-station pseudo-gaps. Large study results are distributed separately as the data release.
